glossary_suggestions: mūrcchanā = 'probably intensification' / मूर्च्छना यानी सम्भवतः प्रबलता (same wording in English and Hindi); amūrta = non-corporeal (u131), abhimūrcchita = overcome (u160): same root, keep both hedged.
Hindi bare बेल = bael; for 'creeper' write लता.
bhavati cātra = 'And on this matter there are:' (u146 now follows this).
Unsplit damaged word: name the printed word in both languages ('akāsanneṣu (unclear)' / 'अकासन्नेषु अस्पष्ट शब्द').
Adjectives agreeing with an unstated noun (pittābhimūrcchite, kapha-pīḍite): gram without gender.
kimuta = 'what to say of' (one word, not kim-uta); no added 'then'.
āma = raw, undigested (no 'material'); āṭopa = gurgling, āntra-kūjana = intestinal murmuring (borborygmus-type, probable) - modern equivalent optional.
snāyu = ligament / स्नायु यानी हड्डियों को बाँधने वाले तन्तु; bisa = lotus stalks / बिस यानी कमलनाल.
